description: One case per toggle: the estate with noAlertReceiver on and nothing else. The known answer is F-ALERT-RECEIVER, the Finding of Check ALERT-RECEIVER, whose severity (High) and fix are the Check's. The narration must name that problem and no other.

setup.toggle: noAlertReceiver, switched on alone from the fixed estate: infra/as-found.ps1 fixed, then infra/as-found.ps1 noAlertReceiver=true

input: Run an Estate health check and tell me what you found.

explanation.rubric: Says the health check found a problem matching: The alerts go to nobody. Does not report any other problem, and does not say the estate is healthy.
